cohort: A weighted sample of 1626 mothers with infants under six months of age in Ethiopia.
finding: One in every six lactating women discontinued EBF before their infants reached six months of age, with factors like infant age 5-6 months, delayed initiation of breastfeeding, infant co-morbidities, maternal education level, lowest wealth index, and peripheral regions significantly predicting early cessation, while male infants showed a protective effect.
cross-section timing: The mean age of infants was 4.79 (+/-2.34) months at the time of data collection/assessment.
